method.candidate: At most one unique strongest measured focus per file; display exact source sentence range
method.gate_per_held_panel: At least three useful locations added over the union of incumbents in separate groups with both generators represented; at most one additional ordinary group and at most two wrong-only candidate files
method.geometry: Complete interior sentence and immediate neighbors in same mapped paragraph; ends in .?!; 12–65 center and 7–80 neighbor words; each full input at most 512 tokens
method.incumbents: First six native contexts at 0.5 and optional longer passage point, as previously measured
method.point: Strict excess over max(0, second highest group maximum across both ordinary views in 14 distinct old F1000Research works)
method.runtime: CPU float32, 2 threads, batch 8, no added weights or online services
method.score: Natural log odds of 1 minus the human softmax response, clipped only to [1e-6, 1-1e-6]
method.shared_drop: Min of drop from left+center and center+right after removing center, divided by square root of its words over 24
method.shared_excess: Min of the two normalized drops and both margins over the normalized drop obtained by removing the adjacent sentence instead
